w4.baby: The embryo has implanted und the placenta is beginning to form.
w4.mom: Du may have just missed dein period. Early hormones are rising.

w5.baby: The neural tube — the start von the brain und spinal cord — is forming.
w5.mom: Early symptoms like tender breasts und fatigue may begin.

w6.baby: A tiny heart begins to beat und pump blood.
w6.mom: Morning sickness can start around now.

w7.baby: Arm und leg buds are appearing; the brain is growing fast.
w7.mom: Dein uterus is starting to expand, though it is not visible yet.

w8.baby: Fingers und toes are forming und tiny movements begin.
w8.mom: Blood volume is increasing to support dein baby.

w9.baby: Essential organs are formed; the baby is now officially a fetus.
w9.mom: Du might notice mood Änderungen von shifting hormones.

w10.baby: Vital organs are working und tiny nails start to develop.
w10.mom: Dein waistline may start to change.

w11.baby: The baby can öffnen und close its fists; bones are hardening.
w11.mom: Nausea often begins to ease in the coming Wochen.

w12.baby: Reflexes are developing; the baby may curl its fingers und toes.
w12.mom: End von the erster trimester is near — energy often returns.

w13.baby: Tiny fingerprints are forming und vocal cords are developing.
w13.mom: Welcome to the second trimester — often the most comfortable.

w14.baby: The baby can make facial expressions und may suck its thumb.
w14.mom: Du may start to feel more like yourself again.

w15.baby: The baby can sense light und is moving amniotic fluid.
w15.mom: Du might notice a little baby bump appearing.

w16.baby: The baby can hear sounds und its heart pumps a lot von blood daily.
w16.mom: Some people feel the erster flutters ("quickening") around now.

w17.baby: Fett stores begin to form und the skeleton hardens.
w17.mom: Dein center of gravity is shifting as your bump grows.

w18.baby: The baby can hear dein voice und may respond to sounds.
w18.mom: Du may feel more defined movements now.

w19.baby: A protective coating (vernix) covers the skin.
w19.mom: Round-ligament aches are common as things stretch.

w20.baby: Halfway there! The baby is swallowing und developing taste buds.
w20.mom: Dein anatomy-scan ultrasound often happens around now.

w21.baby: The baby is moving more, mit regular sleep und wake cycles.
w21.mom: Du may feel kicks more strongly und regularly.

w22.baby: Lips, eyelids und eyebrows are more distinct.
w22.mom: Dein bump is now clearly visible.

w23.baby: The baby can hear loud sounds und is putting an Gewicht.
w23.mom: Swelling in feet und ankles can begin.

w24.baby: The lungs are developing; the baby reaches a viability milestone.
w24.mom: Du may have a glucose screening test soon.

w25.baby: The baby is growing hair und its startle reflex is developing.
w25.mom: Rückseiteaches are common as dein bump grows.

w26.baby: The eyes begin to öffnen und lungs practice breathing motions.
w26.mom: Du might feel rhythmic movements — the baby has hiccups.

w27.baby: Brain activity increases sharply; the baby may recognize dein voice.

w28.baby: The baby can blink und its eyelashes have formed.
w28.mom: Prenatal visits often become more frequent now.

w29.baby: Muscles und lungs fortfahren maturing; bones are fully formed.
w29.mom: Du may feel short von breath as dein uterus rises.

w30.baby: The baby can regulate its own temperature better now.
w30.mom: Fettigue can return in the third trimester.

w31.baby: The baby is putting an Gewicht quickly und moving often.
w31.mom: Du may notice Braxton-Hicks practice contractions.

w32.baby: The lungs are practicing breathing; the baby often settles head-down.
w32.mom: Consider starting dein birth plan und hospital bag.

w33.baby: The baby's bones are hardening, though the skull stays soft.
w33.mom: Du may feel more pressure in dein pelvis.

w34.baby: The central nervous system und lungs are maturing well.
w34.mom: Fettigue und swelling are common; rest when du can.

w35.baby: The baby is filling out; most systems are nearly ready.
w35.mom: Dein provider may check the baby's position.

w36.baby: The baby is likely head-down und gaining ~28 g a Tag.
w36.mom: Wöchentlich checkups usually begin around now.

w37.baby: The baby is considered early term und practicing breathing.
w37.mom: Watch für signs von labor und keep dein bag ready.

w38.baby: Organs are ready für life outside; the baby has a firm grasp.
w38.mom: Du may feel the baby "drop" lower into dein pelvis.

w39.baby: The baby is voll term und ready to meet du.
w39.mom: Any Tag now — watch für regular contractions.

w40.baby: Dein due date is here! Babies arrive on their own schedule.
w40.mom: If labor hasn't started, dein provider will discuss nächste Schritte.

cooked_salmon.name: Cooked salmon
cooked_salmon.note: Well-cooked, low-mercury fish is a great source von omega-3s. Aim für 2–3 servings/Woche.

tuna_canned_light.name: Tuna (canned light)
tuna_canned_light.note: Limit to ~2 servings/Woche; auswählen light over albacore für lower mercury.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.note: High-mercury fish should be avoided during pregnancy.

sushi_raw.name: Sushi (raw)
sushi_raw.note: Raw fish carries a risk von parasites und bacteria. Cooked rolls are fine.

shrimp_cooked.name: Shrimp (cooked)
shrimp_cooked.note: Fully cooked shellfish is low-mercury und safe.

soft_cheese_unpasteurized.name: Soft cheese (unpasteurized)
soft_cheese_unpasteurized.note: Unpasteurized soft cheeses risk listeria. Pasteurized versions are fine.

hard_cheese.name: Hard cheese
hard_cheese.note: Hard und pasteurized cheeses are safe.

pasteurized_milk.name: Pasteurized milk
pasteurized_milk.note: Pasteurized dairy is safe und a good calcium source.

deli_meat_cold.name: Deli meat (cold)
deli_meat_cold.note: Heat until steaming to reduce listeria risk.

undercooked_meat.name: Undercooked meat
undercooked_meat.note: Cook meat thoroughly to avoid toxoplasmosis und bacteria.

cooked_chicken.name: Cooked chicken
cooked_chicken.note: Fully cooked poultry is a safe protein source.

runny_raw_eggs.name: Runny/raw eggs
runny_raw_eggs.note: Cook until firm, or use pasteurized eggs, to avoid salmonella.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.note: Limit caffeine to about 200 mg/Tag (roughly one 12 oz coffee).

alcohol.name: Alcohol
alcohol.note: Keine amount of alcohol is considered safe during pregnancy.

herbal_tea.name: Herbal tea
herbal_tea.note: Some herbs are not recommended; check specific teas mit dein provider.

cooked_leafy_greens.name: Cooked leafy greens
cooked_leafy_greens.note: Wash well; a great source von folate und iron.

unwashed_produce.name: Unwashed produce
unwashed_produce.note: Wash thoroughly; avoid raw sprouts, which can harbor bacteria.

liver_pate.name: Liver / pâté
liver_pate.note: Very high in vitamin A, which can be harmful in large amounts.

peanuts.name: Peanuts
peanuts.note: Safe unless du have a personal allergy; a good protein source.

honey.name: Honey
honey.note: Safe für du in pregnancy (avoid giving to infants under 1 Jahr).

acetaminophen.name: Acetaminophen (Tylenol)
acetaminophen.note: Generally considered erster-line für pain/fever at recommended doses. Bestätigen mit dein provider.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen (Advil)
ibuprofen.note: Avoid especially in the third trimester; use only if dein provider advises.

aspirin.name: Aspirin
aspirin.note: Only low-dose if prescribed; regular-dose aspirin is generally avoided.

prenatal_vitamin.name: Prenatal vitamin
prenatal_vitamin.note: Recommended throughout pregnancy für folic acid, iron und DHA.

antacids_tums.name: Antacids (Tums)
antacids_tums.note: Calcium-based antacids are commonly used für heartburn.

diphenhydramine.name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)
diphenhydramine.note: Often considered okay short-term, but check mit dein provider.

ibuprofen_gel.name: Ibuprofen gel
ibuprofen_gel.note: Discuss topical NSAIDs mit dein provider before use.

isotretinoin.name: Isotretinoin (Accutane)
isotretinoin.note: Retinoids cause serious birth defects und must be avoided.

pseudoephedrine.name: Decongestant (pseudoephedrine)
pseudoephedrine.note: Generally avoided in the erster trimester; ask dein provider.

vitamin_a_high_dose.name: Vitamin A (high dose)
vitamin_a_high_dose.note: High-dose vitamin A can harm the baby; stick to prenatal amounts.
